title: Retry Policy
statement: Implement `solve(kind, idempotent)`. `kind` is `timeout`, `value`, or `unavailable`. `idempotent` is 0 or 1. Return `retry` only for `timeout` or `unavailable` when `idempotent` is 1. Return `stop` for a `value` error always, and for a non-idempotent call even if the kind is transient.
constraints: A timeout on a non-idempotent call stops
hints: If kind is value, return stop.
Otherwise timeout and unavailable retry. Any other kind stops.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Retrying a timeout can repeat a charge when the first request landed.

editorial: Retrying a timeout can repeat a charge when the first request landed. The idempotent flag is the permission to try again. A value error is a bug in the request and will fail the same way. The policy is a conjunction, not a retry of every exception.
